text:
Cassie: Heads-up — AcmeProd reporting repeated 429s and 2–4s tail latency on /v1/generate during this morning’s ramp. They say Dedicated pool didn’t scale up fast enough. Logs and repro below.

Devin: Can you paste the minimal repro and request IDs so I can look?

Cassie: org: acme-prod, route: dedicated-us-east-1, model: psi-large-16k. Spike window ~09:00–09:10 UTC, ~200 req/s. Repro: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-acme-REDACTED' -d '{"input":"ping"}'` — intermittent 429 body: `{"error":"capacity_unavailable","retry_after":30}`. Response headers include `X-Queue-Time: 2.4s`.

Rahul: Pulling autoscaler logs for acme-prod: seeing a lot of queued scale requests. Snippet: `2026-03-18T09:00:01Z scaleRequest org=acme-prod target=28 current=1 reason=traffic_spike` 
`2026-03-18T09:01:23Z scaleAttempt deferred: imagePullBackoff on node gpu-77` 
`2026-03-18T09:01:45Z scaleBackoff activeBackoff=30s lastScale=4943209940`.

Devin: That reads like provisioning is blocked by imagepulls or registry errors rather than pure CPU/GPU shortage. Any kube events or node messages?

Lee: Pasting kube event excerpt and autoscaler lines: 

kube-events:
- Normal Pulling image pullbackoff gcr.io/… manifest unknown
- Warning FailedScheduling 0/8 nodes are available: 3 Insufficient gpu, 5 node(s) had taint

autoscaler log:
[4943211001] scaleRequest acme-prod target=28 current=1 reason=traffic_spike
[4943211023] scaleAttempt deferred due to imagePullBackoff on node gpu-77
[4943211045] scaleAttempt failed: AttachRateLimit from registry

Devin: "AttachRateLimit" — registry returning throttles. Do we mirror images for dedicated?

Nora: Checked cluster quotas — node pool capacity is available, not exhausted. But I see a big spike in concurrent image pulls at 09:00 that caused registry 429s. ImagePullBackoff keeps pods in Pending; autoscaler can't finish attach/start so target never met. This causes front-end queueing and the 429s to clients.

Cassie: Customer mentioned auth token rotation earlier this week for their image registry — could be related if pulls use same service account and rotated badly.

Rahul: Hypothesis: surge -> many pod creations -> concurrent image pulls hit upstream registry rate limits -> imagePullBackoff -> autoscaler backoffs scaling because nodes remain NotReady/unschedulable -> customer sees 429s + queuing. Noisy neighbor GPU hogging seems less likely; primary impediment is registry throttling.

Lee: Short-term mitigations we can apply immediately: 
1) Increase tenant minReplicas for acme-prod from 1 -> 6 (temporary)
2) Enable warm-pool (pre-pulled image nodes) for acme-prod if available
3) Add routing fallback to psi-medium-8k model variant during surge to reduce per-request GPU time
4) Request registry rate limit increase or configure a mirror/cache for dedicated pools

Devin: Can we implement (1) now? I'll apply a tenant override if CS signs off.

Cassie: Go ahead, customer ok with temporary increase.

Devin: Actioning: `tenant.override.minReplicas org=acme-prod value=6 by=devin at=4943212200`

autoscale-bot: tenant.override.minReplicas applied (6) — expected capacity ramp starting now. Observability: https://console.redwood/trace/4943212200

Nora: Watching metrics — pod startup rate improved after override. Image pull errors are still present but staggered restarts reduced contention. Prometheus: `autoscaler_target_replicas{org="acme-prod"} 6 -> 12 -> 20` over next 5m.

Cassie: Customer reports 429s substantially reduced; 95p tail latency now ~200–400ms. They want root cause and permanent fix.

Rahul: Proposed next steps (owner):
- rahul: configure warm-pool / pre-pulled images for acme-prod (ENG-PLATFORM work)
- lee: autoscaler improvement: surface imagePullBackoff as scaling impediment and optionally trigger prioritized warm-pool (ENG-RUNTIME)
- nora: request registry quota/rate-limit increase and check service-account rotation interactions
- devin: monitor the tenant for 24h and rollback override when stable

Lee: Filed tickets: ENG-RUNTIME-1423 "autoscaler: surface imagePullBackoff as scaling impediment" and ENG-PLATFORM-888 "tenant warm-pool / image mirroring for dedicated pools".

Cassie: I'll update CS and send customer the mitigation steps: temporary minReplicas bump, expected timeline, and planned platform improvements.

Devin: Assigning follow-ups in thread: devin -> monitor (24h), rahul -> warm-pool config, lee -> PR for autoscaler detection, nora -> registry quota.

All: :thumbsup: Thanks — keeping this thread for the postmortem notes and timeline.
